metadata.question: Does the plume from Whakaari/White Island, New Zealand travel in a southern direction on January 7, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-2 MSI L1C or L2A (10 m visible / 20 m SWIR) is ideal for daytime volcanic plumes; if no L1C scene exists (often delayed), fall back to L2A or even Landsat 9 OLI (30 m) on the same date (2025-01-07) ±1 day. - Area of interest: a small rectangle (~3 km × 3 km) extending from Whakaari/White Island (−37.52, 176.18) southward to capture any plume. - Date: 2025-01-07 (strict, but will accept 2025-01-06 or 2025-01-08 if no scene on the 7th). 2. Masking/SMALL map strategy: - For Sentinel-2 we’ll use the QA60 band to mask opaque clouds. We do NOT want to mask “maybe” cirrus if the plume is thin – but since the question is “does the plume go south”, we only need to remove thick opaque clouds that completely hide the island/plume. - We will create two sector polygons, both 1 km wide: * SOUTH: centres 1 km due south of the crater (bearing 180°). * NORTH: centres 1 km due north of the crater (bearing 0°) – used as negative control. - Compute mean TOA reflectance in the SWIR band (B12) in each sector (volcanic plumes rich in silicate ash strongly enhance B12) and count valid (non-cloudy) pixels. 3. Decision logic: - If southSector mean B12 > northSector mean B12 AND southSector pixel count > 0, conclude the plume is extending southwards. - Handle missing data first: if zero images, print info then C1. - After cloud-masking, if EITHER sector ends up with 0 valid pixels, print counts and declare C2. - If computed means are None/NaN, output C3. - Otherwise, if south > north, output A (Yes); else B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Area definitions (centred on Whakaari/White Island) crater = ee.Geometry.Point([176.18, -37.52]) southSector = crater.buffer(500).translate(0, -1e4) # 500 m radius disk, 1 km south northSector = crater.buffer(500).translate(0, 1e4) # control disk 1 km north # 2. Image collection search (±1 day tolerance) def grab(col): return (col.filterBounds(crater) .filterDate('2025-01-06','2025-01-09') .sort('system:time_start') .first()) # take the best (earliest) scene available s2l1c = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') img = grab(s2l1c) if img is None or img.id().getInfo() is None: # try L2A or Landsat 9 as fallback img = grab(ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')) or grab(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_TOA')) if img is None or img.id().getInfo() is None: print("No imagery around 2025-01-07.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Cloud cleaning (Sentinel-2 QA60) qa = img.select('QA60') mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<10).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<11).eq(0)) # opaque clouds out img = img.updateMask(mask) # 4. SWIR band stats in each sector def sectorMean(sector): return (img.select('B12') .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=sector, scale=200, maxPixels=1e8) .get('B12')) south = sectorMean(southSector).getInfo() north = sectorMean(northSector).getInfo() count = (img.select('B12') .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=southSector, scale=200, maxPixels=1e8) .get('B12')).getInfo() # 5. Validation if count is None or count == 0: print("Valid pixels south:", count) print("C2") elif south is None or north is None: print("Mean calc failed.") print("C3") else: print("South mean B12:", round(south,3), " Valid pixels:", int(count)) print("North mean B12:", round(north,3)) if south > north: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Area definitions (centred on Whakaari/White Island)
crater = ee.Geometry.Point([176.18, -37.52])
southSector = crater.buffer(500).translate(0, -1e4)   # 500 m radius disk, 1 km south
northSector = crater.buffer(500).translate(0,  1e4)   # control disk 1 km north

# 2. Image collection search (±1 day tolerance)
def grab(col):
    return (col.filterBounds(crater)
            .filterDate('2025-01-06','2025-01-09')
            .sort('system:time_start')
            .first())    # take the best (earliest) scene available
s2l1c = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2')
img = grab(s2l1c)
if img is None or img.id().getInfo() is None:
    # try L2A or Landsat 9 as fallback
    img = grab(ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')) or grab(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_TOA'))
if img is None or img.id().getInfo() is None:
    print("No imagery around 2025-01-07.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Cloud cleaning (Sentinel-2 QA60)
qa = img.select('QA60')
mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<10).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<11).eq(0))  # opaque clouds out
img = img.updateMask(mask)

# 4. SWIR band stats in each sector
def sectorMean(sector):
    return (img.select('B12')
            .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                          geometry=sector, scale=200, maxPixels=1e8)
            .get('B12'))
south = sectorMean(southSector).getInfo()
north = sectorMean(northSector).getInfo()
count = (img.select('B12')
         .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                       geometry=southSector, scale=200, maxPixels=1e8)
         .get('B12')).getInfo()

# 5. Validation
if count is None or count == 0:
    print("Valid pixels south:", count)
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif south is None or north is None:
    print("Mean calc failed.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print("South mean B12:", round(south,3), "  Valid pixels:", int(count))
    print("North mean B12:", round(north,3))
    if south > north:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
